task.title: Wire the independent recovery and restricted re-enrollment wizard
task.input: Real start/enroll/confirm, the OS-owner CLI, and SELF_REAUTH; M3-T6 sign-in form.
task.output: Safe /admin-recovery root layout, RecoveryWizard, recovery client, and a sign-in recovery entry.
task.accept: 1) Entry: Cannot use your authenticator (login-recovery) on /admin-login -> /admin-recovery. Data sources: POST /api/auth-admin/recovery/start/enroll/confirm. Submit an isolated recovery code or OS permit to actual start. Continue the original pending flow with its restricted cookie, which cannot GET admin. Reentry after interruption keeps the URI/deadline unchanged. Expiry requests new authorization without prematurely deleting the original valid factor (E-10, E-11, E-14). 2) Clicking recovery-confirm submits a real new TOTP once and displays new recovery codes. Return to login and actually sign in at the next time step. Old devices/factors reject. Unknown response outcomes do not automatically confirm or retrieve old codes. Without materials, explain OS-owner recovery while the page grants no authority. No password/hash body fields exist; clear memory-only secrets (E-12, E-15). Use the unique minimalist-flat style from section 11. At the actual service at 1920x1080, 1440x900, and 390x844, record GIFs and computed styles: 2px black borders, zero radius, no shadow, and accent #b45700. On each admin page, run D1-D6 and overflow probes with work/form/card and density7/gutter16/gap16/pad16. Labels and keyboard focus are reachable; touch-control targets measure at least 44px. 3) Step-by-step page/network assertions reuse prerequisite recovery-API tests. After clicking login-recovery, URL.pathname is /admin-recovery; the ordinary sign-in form has no required recoveryCode. Clicking recovery-start sends only POST /api/auth-admin/recovery/start with email/credentialKind/credential. Its 200 response contains restricted=true/expiresAt, and the page shows the restricted deadline. Next POST /api/auth-admin/recovery/enroll with body={} returns 200 and the page displays the returned URI. GET /api/admin/account using only the saved restricted cookie returns 401 with no admin data. After refresh/return, Continue setup reenters enroll with URI/expiresAt identical to the previous response. At the deadline, 401/error=recovery_expired hides the pending URI and confirmation input and shows an entry for new recovery authorization. Clicking recovery-confirm sends POST /api/auth-admin/recovery/confirm with body={totp} once. A 200/completed=true response lists recoveryCodes only in that current result panel. After returning to login or pagehide, codes are absent from DOM, localStorage, and sessionStorage. If the service commits but the confirm response is cut off, show confirmation-unknown copy; observe 15 seconds with no second confirm and no code-retrieval request. Return to sign in goes to /admin-login. Selecting no recovery materials only explains contacting the server owner and sends no permit-issuance request. Neither page fields nor confirm requests contain password/newPassword/passwordHash.
